title: feat(spec): an agent's model name becomes optional — absent means the environment's default model
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS4Qk9xEo3NPMmxK8sJfyTfe)_

Fixes #37686

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #37711

## 维护者速读
- 写 agent 元数据的人和 AI：模型块里可以不写模型名，只写温度等参数；不写就用部署的默认模型，写了照旧。没写供应商时也不再自动当成 openai。
- 属于「AI 模型档位」专题第一阶段，按你在决策卡上选的「框架允许省略 model」落地。
- 只放宽不收紧，旧 agent 全部照常解析，运行时行为不变；出问题可直接撤回这个 PR。
- 无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`: `AIModelConfigSchema.model` goes from a required `z.string()` to `z.string().optional()`. Its description now says that an absent model name means the host's default model for the environment. The block stays strict (unknown keys refused); `temperature` still defaults to `0.7`. No sentinel value, no tier key (phase 2 of objectstack-ai/cloud#5055).
- Same file, contract review S1 (seat amendment of the order's step 4): `provider` loses `.default('openai')` and becomes `.optional()`; key and enum unchanged. A block that names no model no longer parses to `provider: 'openai'`, which asserted a provider for a model the host picks. The default move is declared in `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR` under `19` (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`) with its consumer-facing reason, and `authorable-defaults/ai.json` drops the line. No runtime reads an agent's `model.provider`, so no deployed agent changes behaviour. Not retired: enforce-or-remove for `provider` is #37712.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts`: six new cases (temperature-only block parses with `model` undefined; an explicit name is carried as written; an unknown key is still refused as `unrecognized_keys`; a non-string name is still refused; a whole agent with `model: { temperature: 0.2 }` parses; a block with no `provider` parses without one, a written one is carried, an off-enum one is refused), and the minimal-config case now expects no `provider`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.tsx` (contract review S2, file surface widened by the seat): the model pill showed only when `model.provider` was set, so a block naming a model and no provider lost the model name once the default was gone. It now shows when a model or a provider is written and reads `PROVIDER · MODEL`, `MODEL` or `PROVIDER`; a block that names neither shows no pill, so the environment default is not given a name. Two new cases in `AgentPreview.test.tsx`.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/ai/agent.mdx` (`gen:docs`) and `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ai.json` (written by the build). authorable-surface, api-surface, the JSON-schema manifest and the metadata-form translations needed no change: the key set is unchanged, and the translations carry only the `model.model` label.
- `.changeset/37686-agent-model-name-optional.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, with the three declaration lines; `semantic` because a default moved (it outranks `added`).

Read first (by risk): `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` (the two contract hunks), `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts` (the declared default move), then the changeset.

## Tests

All at head `b3238ea8`, run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared container. The spec readings were taken at `db5f0e7d`; the only later commit touches `ui/` and the changeset prose.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/agent.test.ts` → Test Files 1 passed, Tests 70 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.emptyCollection-8520.test.tsx` → Test Files 2 passed, Tests 24 passed.
- Ablations (each fix committed first, the mutation made on disk, then restored from HEAD): without `model`'s `.optional()`, Tests 2 failed / 67 passed; with `provider`'s `.default('openai')` restored, Tests 3 failed / 67 passed; with the preview pill keyed on `provider` again, Tests 1 failed / 17 passed (the name-only case). The other new cases pin behaviour that holds either way.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 903 passed (903), Tests 28557 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0 (includes `check:test-typecheck`, 52 files held in the ledger, unchanged).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → exit 0 after `gen:docs`; the build's default ratchet accepts the declared `ai/AIModelConfig:provider` move.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` has no `typecheck` script; its types are `Type Check UI`'s, read from this PR's check-runs.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 117 families for this change set at `b3238ea8` (the three new ones read `ui/`: `check-sdui-manifest` and its self-test, and `vitest run scripts/` under `ui/`); each was run and its exit code captured before any pipe, all 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "117 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 117 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 117 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Families outside the derivation (repo-wide lint, UI lanes, Test Core's repo project) are CI's.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-checked on `origin/main` 6d106a1a: the card's `Re-check:` grep answers 1 hit at `agent.zod.ts:38`.
- Readers of an agent's `model.model` in this repo: `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-list-registry.ts` (list column; `valueAtPath` answers `undefined`, so the cell is empty for an agent with no model, which is the card's "empty/default" outcome); `AgentPreview.tsx` (its model pill, reworked here for S2, renders only what is written); tests only otherwise. None breaks on `undefined`. In cloud (read-only, `origin/main` 63427ae), `packages/service-ai/src/agent-runtime.ts:1028` assigns `options.model = agent.model.model`, so an absent name leaves `options.model` undefined there; how cloud resolves that to its default is the cloud card's (objectstack-ai/cloud#5055) after a pin move.
- `provider`: declared, not enforced. No runtime in this repo reads an agent's `model.provider`, and in cloud `origin/main` 63427ae `agent-runtime.ts` reads only `model`, `temperature` and `maxTokens` from the agent's block (the `model.provider` read in `vercel-adapter.ts:391` is the AI SDK model object, not the agent config). Its default is dropped here (S1); keep-or-retire is #37712.
- Display (S2): the preview reads the raw draft, so a draft that wrote a model and no provider showed no pill even before this PR; the S2 fix shows its name either way. A parsed or stored block no longer carries an invented `openai`.
- Skills docs: `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` "Model Configuration" still teaches `model` as a required free string with `provider` default `openai`, and cites `agent.zod.ts:36-40`; the `skills-tools-knowledge` eval expects "a free-string `model`". Follow-up #37711.
- Overlap: #37676 also opens a `19` bucket in `default-changes.ts` (and touches `authorable-defaults/ai.json`); `main` merges cleanly here, the two PRs conflict textually there, and whichever lands second keeps both entries.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/agent.test.ts` → 70 passed; revert the `model` `.optional()` and two of the new cases go red; restore the `provider` default and three go red.
